dialogs.about: 먼저 할 일과 나중에 할 일 정하기

lines.en: What should we do first today?
Let's wash the clothes first. We can rest later.
I already washed them this morning.
Really? You got up early this morning.
Yes. What will we do after lunch?
lines.ko: 네. 점심 후에는 뭘 할 거예요?

lines.en: We will go to the garden during the afternoon.
Is the mail still on the table?
No, I read it before breakfast.
Good. The last thing is a walk this evening.
Great. Don't be late for dinner!
I'm sorry, Teacher. I'm late.
That's fine. What happened?
The bus came late this morning.
Did you wait a long time this morning?
Yes. I waited thirty minutes before it came.
lines.ko: 네. 버스가 오기 전에 삼십 분 기다렸어요.

lines.en: Are you all right now?
Yes. Did the class already start before I came?
lines.ko: 네. 제가 오기 전에 수업이 이미 시작했어요?

lines.en: We only started five minutes ago.
Next time I will leave early.
Good idea. Soon you will be the first one here.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 곧 제일 먼저 오시게 될 거예요.
